content.key_idea: A centralized scheduler with a paged KV cache manager coordinates multiple distributed GPU workers, each running a model shard and a local cache engine that share a common block mapping.

evidence: The architecture of vLLM is shown in Fig. 4.
vLLM adopts a centralized scheduler to coordinate the execution of distributed GPU workers.
vLLM includes a CPU block allocator to manage the physical blocks swapped to CPU RAM

summary: vLLM is an LLM serving system built around PagedAttention, an attention algorithm that manages the KV cache like paged virtual memory to eliminate fragmentation and enable memory sharing. Figure 4 gives the system overview: a centralized Scheduler coordinates a KV Cache Manager, which tracks logical-to-physical block mappings in block tables and delegates physical memory management to a GPU Block Allocator and a CPU Block Allocator (used for swapping evicted blocks to CPU RAM). The scheduler broadcasts control messages, including per-request block tables, to a set of distributed GPU workers (Worker 0 through Worker N-1), each pairing a local Cache Engine with a shard of the model. The diagram is a simple color-coded box layout with the scheduler-side components on the left and the repeated worker units stacked on the right.
summary_zh: 图4展示vLLM系统架构：绿色调度器（Scheduler）通过KV缓存管理器和CPU/GPU块分配器管理分页KV缓存，并向右侧多个分布式GPU Worker（各含缓存引擎和模型分片）广播控制消息。
